title: Minimality of the limit and convergence of the mass measures for all representations (Simon 7.2.4 (8), (12)–(14))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. For j ∈ ℕ let U_j ⊆ ℝ^P be open and S_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U_j), and let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity. Assume (1) for every R ∈ ℝ, closedBall(0, R) ⊆ U_j for all large j; (2) S_j ⇀ C in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly: currentEval(S_j, ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P)); (3) (local comparison) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, every ε > 0 and every strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ there are an open W with K ⊆ W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) and a strictly increasing φ' : ℕ → ℕ such that limsup_i M_W(S_{ψ(φ'(i))}) ≤ M_W(S) for every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with SameBoundary S C and spt(S − C) ⊆ K. Then C is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ) and μ_{S_j} → μ_C for all integer multiplicity representations (MassMeasuresConverge S C: for all IMReps R_j of S_j in U_j and R of C in ℝ^P and every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫ f dR_j.measure → ∫ f dR.measure).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ j, IsOpen (Us j)) → (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → ConvergesWeakly Ss C → (∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S → SameBoundary S C → (S - C).support ⊆ K → limsup (fun j => (Ss (ψ (φ' j))).massOn W) atTop ≤ S.massOn W) → IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ MassMeasuresConverge Ss C
